name: Early twentieth century
description: Electric light is new, empires are cracking, and the old mage families still believe the modern world will pass them by.

name: Postwar years
description: The world is rebuilding after catastrophe. Old lineages are broke, and new ones are hungry.

name: Late twentieth century
description: Television, telephones and traffic everywhere. Hiding magic from ordinary people has never been harder.

name: New millennium
description: Everyone carries a camera in their pocket. A war of mages now has to be fought between the security cameras.
